claims.text: The function uses the CRC-32 polynomial 0xEDB88320.
Returns 0 when the input length is 0.
Returns VERA_ERR when the output capacity is smaller than the input length.
Writes exactly param_2 bytes to out and never modifies in.
The function uses a nested loop to compute the CRC-32 checksum.
